scope: All nine exact admitted routines.other.rst selectors; no page-wide semantic/implementation ownership inference.

reviewed_operations.source_operation: Broadcast shape descriptors under NumPy compatibility rules; returns a tuple and raises ValueError for incompatible shapes. Source constructs zero-itemsize dummy arrays and delegates shape broadcasting; constructor conversion/errors remain part of the profile.

Default max_work=-1 requests exact byte-overlap determination. Work-limited/overflow/errors and array/protocol coercion are observable; do not equate this with a shared base-object test or a universal bounds-only query.

Default max_work=0 checks memory extents conservatively: True may be a false positive for actual overlapping element bytes. Finite-work solver uncertainty/overflow becomes True in the native may-share path; parser/conversion errors still propagate.

Returns the NumPy C-header include directory using source-tree vs installed-core path branches. This is distinct from numpy.f2py.get_include(), which locates fortranobject.c/h. Native header/build owner remains an explicit design exception.

Set ufunc buffer size, return prior size, and store updated extobj in the context variable. Since NumPy2.0 errstate context exit restores buffer scope. Source rejects size<0; _make_extobj conversion/validation and concurrency composition remain to specify.
Read current ufunc buffer size from extobj context and return an int. This is ufunc execution configuration rather than profiling/testing output.
Print help/array/object/module information, search names for string inputs, or show its own help for None; output target and inspection effects remain operation-specific.
Display active SIMD/runtime-library information; optional threadpoolctl availability and stdout diagnostics are distinct source branches.
Delegate to generated build-configuration show(mode), supporting output/dictionary variants and invalid-mode errors; actual generated build values remain build-specific.

overlap_contract.scope: Built-in/native computation after successful protocol selection. __array_function__ overrides may return arbitrary objects; preserve their identities/effects and do not impose the native bool result contract on custom outputs.
overlap_contract.representation: Byte address sets include each descriptor's element itemsize, index extents and strides. Sharing a base pointer or intersecting bounding boxes alone does not prove exact byte overlap.
overlap_contract.shares_memory: Exact overlap by default (-1); finite work can raise TooHardError and native solver overflow can raise OverflowError. max_work parsing/coercion and array-function overrides remain separate branches.
overlap_contract.may_share_memory: Bounds-only by default (0), so True means possible sharing. Native solver NO/YES map to False/True; uncertainty/overflow conservatively maps to True. Actual invocation/parser/coercion failures are not generally swallowed.

doc_native_conflict.description: shares_memory source doc says max_work=0 is equivalent to may_share_memory. Frozen native shares path passes raise_exceptions=1; if bounds intersect, the solver returns MEM_OVERLAP_TOO_HARD at max_work=0 and that path raises TooHardError, whereas may-share returns True. Preserve this discrepancy pending exact runtime/dispatch verification; neither silently merge contracts nor waive a reference-definedness question.
